evidence: Library shows 6 templates, each card displays author (e.g. Sarah Chen), description, category/scenario tags, use count, update date.
Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume opened a dialog with the template's fill form.
All 14 form fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, Start/End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Grad Year, Skills) accepted input via fill_form successfully.
"Preview Result" tab became enabled after filling required fields and displayed rendered resume matching entered data.
Each card shows template name (heading), author, description, category/scenario type tags, and "Updated <date>".
Preview shows John Smith, Software Engineer, all entered summary/experience/education/skills text rendered correctly matching form input, in Markdown converted to headings/paragraphs.
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" invoked navigator.clipboard.writeText with full Markdown source matching the preview content (verified via spy on clipboard API).
Before filling fields, "Preview Result" tab was disabled and an alert listed missing required fields; after filling all required fields, tab became enabled.
An alert box "Required fields missing" with list of missing fields appeared when required fields were empty, and Preview tab was disabled.
Preview rendered proper headings, bold/italic text, separators from Markdown source without formatting errors.
Clicking heart/favorite icon in dialog added "fill-current" class to heart SVG (visually filled) and Favorites button badge updated to "1" immediately.
Favoriting a template persisted; Favorites view showed "Showing 1 of 6 templates" with the saved template.
Toggling "Favorites" filter switched the grid to only show favorited template(s); search box remains available in this view.

Category filter (e.g. "Resume") and Scenario filter (e.g. "Academic") correctly narrowed results; Sort By "Recently Updated" reordered list by update date descending (Dec 5 > Dec 1 > Nov 28...); default "Most Popular" ordered by use count descending.
Typing partial keyword "resu" in search box matched "Professional Resume" via fuzzy substring match and filtered the grid to 1 result with a suggestion dropdown.

Typing "resu" showed a real-time suggestion button "Professional Resume"; clicking it filled the search box with the full template name and filtered the results to show only that corresponding template.
Grid updated instantly (no page reload) upon typing in search box and upon changing Category/Scenario/Sort filters.
Clicking "Submit Template" with all fields empty (title, author, description, content) showed toast "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and did not submit.

actual: Typed special characters (¥#@%^*) into Template Title, Author Name, Description, and Template Content fields in the Submit Template form. All were accepted verbatim with no filtering, blocking, or "Special characters are prohibited" message shown.

issue: No visual feedback for special character input
actual: Entering special characters (¥#@%^*) into form fields produced no visual feedback (no error styling, no blocked input, no warning message).

evidence: Submitted a custom Markdown template "My Custom Report" with title, author, description, category, scenario, markdown content using {{field}} placeholders, and two custom date fields. Toast confirmed "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."
After submission, "My Custom Report" by QA Tester appeared immediately in the public template library grid (now showing 7 of 7 templates) with a "Use Template" button.

Library counter updated from "6 of 6" to "7 of 7" immediately after submission, without needing a page reload, and the new card rendered with correct data (name, author, description, tags, update date, 0 uses).

The custom "date" field type renders as a native HTML input type="date". Attempting to programmatically set an invalid date string (2026-13-45) resulted in the input value being rejected (empty string), confirming browser-level date-format validation is enforced.

actual: Entered Start Date 2026-09-10 and End Date 2026-09-01 (end before start) in a template with date fields. No error/warning was shown, the Preview Result tab remained enabled, and clicking it generated a preview without any date-order validation message.

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submission
actual: Submitted a template with deliberately malformed Markdown (unclosed code fence, unclosed bold, broken link syntax, incomplete table) and it was accepted immediately with the success toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library." No warning about invalid/broken Markdown syntax was shown.
